title: Optionally use fpng encoder for much faster movie writing
body:
This PR proposes a compile-time flag to use [fpng](https://github.com/richgel999/fpng/) for PNG encoding instead of libpng.

On my machine (2023 Macbook Pro, M2 Max, 64 GB memory, macOS 15.2), there's a **15-fold** difference in rendering speed for movie maker mode, and I'm now able to write these videos at almost realtime 50 FPS speed.

The downside is that `fpng` only supports encoding RGB and RGBA frames, which is why this is disabled by default.

### No fpng (`scons dev_mode=yes no_editor_splash=yes fpng=no`)
